description: Read the signed-in member's ranked "Needs you" list: the findings, pull request fixes, retests, join requests, reports, billing problems and waiting repairs that are theirs to act on, each with the one reason it reaches them (Yours, Nobody owns it yet, Raised to you, You're an admin, You manage billing). The same list Home shows. Admins also get a summary of items with teammates, and every role is told of a code connection whose sign-in stopped (stoppedConnections). Never changes anything; snooze_attention_items and nudge_attention_owners do.
name: my_attention
title: What needs me
